value.description: Write-only secret value. Never included in responses or diagnostics.
Write-only secret value. Never included in responses or diagnostics.

en.reason: The operation could not be confirmed.
en.action: Inspect its status using the diagnostic ID.

zh-CN.reason: 无法确认操作结果。
zh-CN.action: 请使用诊断 ID 检查状态。

en.reason: The operation was refused.
en.action: Check its configuration and current state.

zh-CN.reason: 操作被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请检查配置和当前状态。

en.reason: Permission for this operation was denied.
en.action: Ask an administrator to review the applicable policy before retrying.

zh-CN.reason: 此操作的权限被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请管理员复核适用策略后再重试。

en.reason: The full-access authority was revoked.
en.action: Refresh the session permission and request a new approval.

zh-CN.reason: 完全访问授权已撤销。
zh-CN.action: 请刷新会话权限并重新请求审批。

en.reason: The permission grant is missing, expired or already consumed.
en.action: Request a new approval for this action.

zh-CN.reason: 权限授权缺失、已过期或已使用。
zh-CN.action: 请为此操作重新请求审批。

en.reason: The preset or permission selection was refused.
en.action: Choose a supported preset and a compatible permission level.

zh-CN.reason: 预设或权限选择被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请选择受支持的预设及兼容的权限级别。

en.reason: The requested model is not available in this profile.
en.action: Run `agh doctor provider` to list the configured routes and choose one of them.

zh-CN.reason: 当前配置中没有所请求的模型。
zh-CN.action: 运行 `agh doctor provider` 查看已配置的路由，并从中选择。

en.reason: The requested model or route is not in the configured model catalogue.
en.action: Run `agh doctor provider` to list the configured routes and their models, and choose one of them.

zh-CN.reason: 所请求的模型或路由不在已配置的模型目录中。
zh-CN.action: 运行 `agh doctor provider` 查看已配置的路由及其模型，并从中选择。

en.reason: A saved account or model change is not active until the daemon restarts, so the requested model is not loaded yet.
en.action: Restart the daemon with `agh daemon stop`; the next agh command starts it with the saved configuration. If the model is still refused, run `agh doctor provider` to list the configured routes.

zh-CN.reason: 已保存的账户或模型改动需重启后台才生效，所请求的模型尚未加载。
zh-CN.action: 运行 `agh daemon stop` 重启后台；下一条 agh 命令会以已保存的配置启动它。若仍被拒绝，运行 `agh doctor provider` 查看已配置的路由。

en.reason: The preset cannot accept the requested permission overlay.
en.action: Choose a compatible preset and permission level; required isolation must remain enabled.

zh-CN.reason: 预设无法接受请求的权限叠加。
zh-CN.action: 请选择兼容的预设和权限级别，并保留必需的隔离。

en.reason: The action was rejected during approval.
en.action: Ask the reviewer before submitting the action again.

zh-CN.reason: 此操作在审批时被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 再次提交前请先询问审核人。

en.reason: The operation was refused by the budget limit.
en.action: Review the remaining budget and limits before trying again.

zh-CN.reason: 操作因预算限制被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请检查剩余预算和上限后再重试。

en.reason: Plugin publication was refused by trust or capability policy.
en.action: Review the candidate, declared capabilities and publication approval.

zh-CN.reason: 插件发布被信任或能力策略拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请复核候选、声明的能力及发布审批。

en.reason: The plugin test was refused.
en.action: Review the test approval and sandbox requirements before retrying.

zh-CN.reason: 插件测试被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请复核测试审批和沙箱要求后再重试。

en.reason: The required backend is unavailable.
en.action: Check its configuration and compatibility.

zh-CN.reason: 所需后端不可用。
zh-CN.action: 请检查配置和兼容性。

en.reason: The resource changed.
en.action: Reload the latest state before retrying.

zh-CN.reason: 资源已变更。
zh-CN.action: 请重新载入最新状态后重试。

en.reason: The resource is busy.
en.action: Wait for the current operation to finish.

zh-CN.reason: 资源正在使用中。
zh-CN.action: 请等待当前操作结束。

en.reason: Authentication was refused.
en.action: Reconnect and authenticate again.

zh-CN.reason: 认证被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请重新连接并认证。

en.reason: The request parameters were refused.
en.action: Check the parameters and submit a valid request.

zh-CN.reason: 请求参数被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请检查参数并提交有效请求。

en.reason: The request is not valid.
en.action: Check the request format.

zh-CN.reason: 请求无效。
zh-CN.action: 请检查请求格式。

en.reason: This operation is unavailable.
en.action: Use a supported operation.

zh-CN.reason: 此操作不可用。
zh-CN.action: 请使用受支持的操作。

en.reason: The session or resource is unavailable.
en.action: Refresh the resource list.

zh-CN.reason: 会话或资源不可用。
zh-CN.action: 请刷新资源列表。

en.reason: Image and video generation models cannot be used for chat.
en.action: Choose a chat-capable model in model settings.

zh-CN.reason: 图片或视频生成模型不能用于对话。
zh-CN.action: 请在模型设置中选择支持对话的模型。

en.reason: A provider credential is required.
en.action: Add a credential for this provider.

zh-CN.reason: 缺少提供方凭据。
zh-CN.action: 请为此提供方添加凭据。

en.reason: The credential was rejected.
en.action: Check it and try again.

zh-CN.reason: 凭据被拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 请检查后重试。

en.reason: The credential could not be stored.
en.action: Check storage access.

zh-CN.reason: 无法保存凭据。
zh-CN.action: 请检查存储权限。

en.reason: The selected provider cannot serve this request.
en.action: Check plugin state and compatibility.

zh-CN.reason: 所选提供方无法处理请求。
zh-CN.action: 请检查插件状态和兼容性。

en.reason: The pinned plugin generation is unavailable or incompatible.
en.action: Review the plugin generation and session recovery options.

zh-CN.reason: 固定的插件代际不可用或不兼容。
zh-CN.action: 请检查插件代际和会话恢复选项。

en.reason: This session was written by a newer AGH version.
en.action: Upgrade AGH to continue; history remains readable.

zh-CN.reason: 此会话由更新版本的 AGH 写入。
zh-CN.action: 请升级 AGH 后再继续；仍可查看历史。

en.reason: This session needs an older plugin version.
en.action: Read its history or start a new session; an administrator can migrate it.

zh-CN.reason: 此会话需要旧版插件。
zh-CN.action: 可查看历史或新开会话；管理员可以迁移会话。

en.reason: This session failed an integrity check.
en.action: Keep its history for diagnosis and start a new session.

zh-CN.reason: 此会话未通过完整性检查。
zh-CN.action: 请保留历史用于诊断，并新开会话。

en.reason: The memory file exceeds its limits.
en.action: Consolidate it within the file size and line limits; the previous file was kept.

zh-CN.reason: 记忆文件超出限制。
zh-CN.action: 请整理至文件大小和行数上限内；原文件已保留。

en.reason: Secret-like content cannot be saved as memory.
en.action: Remove credentials before saving.

zh-CN.reason: 疑似凭据的内容不能保存到记忆。
zh-CN.action: 请移除凭据后再保存。

en.reason: Memory is disabled.
en.action: Review the memory setting before requesting access.

zh-CN.reason: 记忆已关闭。
zh-CN.action: 请复核记忆设置后再请求访问。

en.reason: The file was saved, but writer metadata failed.
en.action: Reload to inspect the saved file.

zh-CN.reason: 文件已保存，但写入来源记录失败。
zh-CN.action: 请重新载入检查已保存的文件。

en.reason: The operation timed out.
en.action: Inspect its status before retrying.

zh-CN.reason: 操作超时。
zh-CN.action: 请检查状态后再重试。

en.reason: This session has missing or incompatible execution isolation records.
en.action: Read its history and start a new session to continue working.

zh-CN.reason: 此会话的执行隔离记录缺失或不匹配。
zh-CN.action: 可以查看历史；请新建会话以继续工作。

en.reason: The provider rate limit was reached.
en.action: Wait before submitting another request.

zh-CN.reason: 已达到提供方速率限制。
zh-CN.action: 请稍后再提交请求。

en.reason: The model output limit was reached.
en.action: Reduce the requested output or review the model limits.

zh-CN.reason: 已达到模型输出限制。
zh-CN.action: 请减少请求的输出或复核模型上限。

en.reason: Plugin publication requires a current human review.
en.action: Open the candidate review, inspect its tests and permissions, then approve or reject it there.

zh-CN.reason: 插件发布需要当前有效的人工审核。
zh-CN.action: 请打开候选审核，检查测试和权限，并在那里批准或拒绝。

en.reason: The provider could not be reached, or it answered with a server error.
en.action: Check connectivity and try again later. If it keeps happening, the provider may be down.

zh-CN.reason: 无法连接提供方，或提供方返回了服务器错误。
zh-CN.action: 请检查网络后稍后再试；如果持续出现，可能是提供方暂时不可用。

en.reason: The provider refused this model or its credentials.
en.action: Pick another model or sign in again.

zh-CN.reason: 提供方拒绝了所选模型或凭据。
zh-CN.action: 请选择其他模型或重新登录。

en.reason: The fork boundary must be a completed turn.
en.action: Choose a completed turn/end sequence.

zh-CN.reason: 分支起点必须是已完成的轮次。
zh-CN.action: 请选择已完成的 turn/end 序号。

en.reason: The selected agent bundle is unavailable.
en.action: Install, enable and trust the bundle, or choose another agent.

zh-CN.reason: 所选 Agent 组合不可用。
zh-CN.action: 请安装、启用并信任该组合，或选择其他 Agent。

en.reason: No model provider is configured for this profile.
en.action: Run agh config to add a provider.

zh-CN.reason: 当前配置尚未设置模型提供方。
zh-CN.action: 请运行 agh config 添加提供方。

en.reason: The selected Loop is not installed.
en.action: Install its pinned ID and version before retrying.

zh-CN.reason: 所选 Loop 尚未安装。
zh-CN.action: 请安装其固定的 ID 和版本后再重试。

en.reason: Required execution isolation is unavailable.
en.action: Choose an available sandbox or review the required isolation settings.

zh-CN.reason: 必需的执行隔离不可用。
zh-CN.action: 请选择可用的沙箱，或复核必需隔离设置。

en.reason: This home or request uses a retired preview format.
en.action: Select a new, empty private AGH_HOME, configure it again, and use explicit recipe and permission fields. No data conversion or old trust is carried over.

zh-CN.reason: 该 home 或请求使用了已退役的预览格式。
zh-CN.action: 请使用新的空私有 AGH_HOME，重新配置，并分别指定配方与权限。不会转换旧数据或沿用旧信任。
